scope: New nonfinancial full-width phase; existing live financial controller unchanged
query_order: Each of ten consecutive 5m maxindices: aliases0 through5; identical frozen windows in each mode
native_interfaces: Original DataProvider _set_cached_df and get_analyzed_dataframe; source history/load precision sideeffect/advise_all_indicators/ft_advise_signals, no Backtesting or Wallets construction
memory_design: Use one source frame object for six assignments; do not manufacture six in-memory copies. Legacy disk reload naturally creates separate frames. Release each mode before next.

measurement.timing: source setup+indicator computation, native signals, mapping write, first cycle, remaining9 cycles, exact validation separately
measurement.legacy_reader: original writer/eviction including byte serialization check; instrumented reader keeps compressed stream+buffered pickle load, adds own-generated file SHA and compressed/decompressed byte counters
measurement.initial_read_cache_clear: legacy alias references discarded once after all writes outside timing; blocks naturally cold, no clearing during timed60reads
measurement.proof: exact native slices including dtype/index/columns/attrs/flags/calendar/numericbits; no market returns or six-asset claim

resource_limits.enforcement: worker phase checks plus separate parent supervisor polls own worker; terminate on observed breach, preserve partial receipts
